# Grantley Keith Telfer

**Role:** Mark's uncle — brother of Timothy Neil Telfer
**Residence:** Stokes, South Australia
---

## Family

| Relation | Name |
|----------|------|
| **Mother** | [[Shirley Edna Telfer (1929–2017)]] |
| **Father** | [[Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)]] |
| **Siblings** | [[Daryll William Telfer]], [[John Robert Telfer]], [[Timothy Neil Telfer (1959–?)]], [[Kathryn Mavis Telfer (1961–1965)]], [[Susan Shirley Lawrie (?–living)]] |
| **Children** | [[Kristin Stefanoff]], Jono Telfer, Nick Telfer |

---

## Life Summary

Grantley recorded Murray's life memories that were compiled into the memorial book [[Celebrating the life of Murray John Telfer]]. He lives in Stokes, South Australia — the Eyre Peninsula region where the Telfer family has deep roots.

Grantley has three children: [[Kristin Stefanoff]] (married Ben Stefanoff, lives in Nairne, SA), Jono Telfer, and Nick Telfer.
